jobs.occupation: Office manager / Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer
jobs.description:
Our client is an industrial company specialized in the manufacturing of technical products. Part of an international group, the organization offers a dynamic, hands-on environment where flexibility, autonomy, and collaboration are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

As an Office Manager/ Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer your responsibilities are:

• Act as the main point of contact for customer administrative inquiries.
• Coordinate supplier orders and monitor procurement activities.
• Organize shipments and oversee logistics operations.
• Process and monitor customer and supplier invoices.
• Support accounting administration and cash flow follow-up.
• Manage HR administration and prepare payroll-related information.
• Contribute to the ERP transition from Odoo to SAP and support process adaptation.
• Manage customer orders from receipt through to delivery.
• Client-focused mindset with excellent relationship management skills, ensuring coordination across production capacity and delivery.

A successful Office Manager/ Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer should have:

• Proven experience as an Office Manager, Administrative Manager, or Administrative Coordinator.
• Experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
• Good understanding of sales administration, procurement, and supply chain processes.
• Comfortable managing customer orders, suppliers, and logistics coordination.
• Strong IT skills and experience working with ERP systems.
• Knowledge of Odoo and/or SAP is considered an asset.
• Fluent in French with a good command of English.
• Autonomous, organized, solution-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.

Our client is a well-established organization combining the agility of a human-sized company with the stability and resources of a leading international group.As part of its continued growth and professionalization, the company is looking to strengthen its finance team with a high-potential finance professional. This role is specifically designed for someone who wants to transition from an External Audit or Financial Controlling background into a broader business-oriented finance position.You will initially join as a Business Controller, working closely with the Finance Director and gaining exposure to all aspects of the business. Over time, the objective is for you to develop into a Finance Manager position, taking increased ownership of financial steering, business partnering and team coordination.This is an ideal opportunity for an ambitious auditor looking to move into industry and build a long-term leadership career within finance.

Jobomschrijving

As Business Controller, you will support the Finance Director in driving financial performance, improving reporting processes and providing valuable insights to management.You will progressively expand your responsibilities and become a key finance partner for operational stakeholders across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Participate in monthly closing activities and financial reporting.
• Analyze financial performance and identify key business trends.
• Support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning exercises.
• Develop management reporting and KPI dashboards.
• Challenge business results and provide actionable recommendations.
• Work closely with operational managers to improve profitability and efficiency.
• Assist in the implementation and optimization of financial processes and controls.
• Contribute to strategic projects and business improvement initiatives.
• Support ad hoc analyses for senior management.
• Gradually take ownership of broader finance responsibilities in preparation for a future Finance Manager role.

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business Administration.
• Min. 5 years of experience within a controlling role or in a Big 4 or external audit environment.
• Strong analytical mindset and genuine interest in understanding business operations.
• Ambition to move from audit into a business-facing finance role.
• Ability to communicate with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
• Proactive, hands-on and eager to take ownership.
• Comfortable working in an environment where continuous improvement is encouraged.
• Strong Excel skills; experience with SAP is a great asset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory). French is considered a plus.

Our client is an international B2B technology company active within the pharmaceutical industry. As Marketing & Product Strategy Manager, you will be responsible for shaping product strategy, market positioning, and thought leadership initiatives while acting as the link between customers, scientific experts, engineering teams, and commercial stakeholders.

Jobomschrijving

As a Marketing & Product Strategy Manager your responsibilities are:

• Define and execute the overall product and marketing strategy.
• Drive product positioning and go-to-market initiatives across international markets.
• Gather market insights and translate customer needs into product roadmap recommendations.
• Collaborate with R&D, engineering, scientific, and commercial teams.
• Manage the product lifecycle from launch through continuous improvement.
• Develop technical and scientific content to strengthen market visibility.
• Represent the business through conferences, webinars, trade fairs, and industry events.

A successful Marketing & Product Strategy Manager should have:

• Master's degree in Marketing, Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
• At least 7 years of experience in Product Marketing and/or Product Management within a B2B environment.
• Ability to translate complex scientific and technical concepts into compelling commercial value propositions.
• Proven experience working with technical, engineering, scientific, or industrial stakeholders.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging international audiences.
• Charismatic, optimistic, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership in a growing business.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Our client is a leading international transportation company operating complex, multi-country services and focused on service reliability, operational efficiency and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive operational performance improvement initiatives, monitoring KPIs, punctuality, service regularity and overall operational efficiency.
• Coordinate daily, weekly and monthly performance governance meetings, ensuring action plans are tracked and delivered.
• Analyze operational performance gaps, conduct root-cause investigations and develop measurable improvement plans.
• Lead the deployment of operational excellence projects and harmonize processes, tools and best practices across business functions.
• Prepare executive-level reporting, dashboards, performance reviews and stakeholder communications while ensuring governance, documentation and traceability.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Program Management or a related field.
• Proven experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement and performance management, ideally within the transportation sector.
• Strong project management capabilities with experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, workstreams and strategic initiatives simultaneously.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to transform operational data into actionable recommendations and sustainable improvement plans.
• Fluent in French and English, with strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills in multicultural environments.

jobs.occupation: AP / Junior Accountant - Sint Pieters Leeuw - English + Fr / Du
jobs.description:
As an AP / Junior Accountant in Sint-Pieters-Leeuw, you will handle day-to-day accounting tasks within the industrial sector and help keep financial records accurate. You will work in the Accounting & Finance department, contributing to clear and timely processing of financial information.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a stable player based in the south of Brussels. You will join a strong and supportive team, where your onboarding will be coordinated by several colleagues to ensure a smooth integration into the company.

Omschrijving

As an AP / Junior Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Process supplier invoices and ensure that accounting data is entered accurately.
• Processing bank transactions.
• Managing supplier master data
• Check invoice details against available documentation to maintain reliable records.
• Help maintain up-to-date supplier account information for daily finance activities.
• Follow up on missing invoice details and resolve basic processing queries.
• Reconcile invoice information with accounting records to identify differences.
• Support the preparation of regular finance reports with accurate data.
• Contribute to efficient administrative processes within the Accounting & Finance department.

• Bachelor or Master in Accounting (or equivalent through experience).
• Ability to process invoices with care and accuracy.
• You have an excellent command of English and are fluent in either French or Dutch, with a good working knowledge of the other language.
• Comfort working with routine accounting and administrative tasks.
• Ability to prepare clear and accurate financial information.
• A hands-on mindset with a genuine desire to learn and grow.

Our client is a specialized consultancy company with a unique market position, having worked exclusively with the same international aviation industry leader for more than 15 years. This long-term partnership offers an exceptional combination of stability, expertise, and continuous technological evolution.Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

Jobomschrijving

As a Data Engineer / BI Consultant, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's data ecosystem.Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines within a Snowflake environment.
• Working with SQL and Linux/Bash to support data integration, automation, and transformation processes.
• Implementing and maintaining solutions within a modern Data Mesh architecture combining Data Lake and Data Warehouse principles.
• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of data flows and reporting solutions.
• Collaborating closely with international business stakeholders located across multiple countries and time zones.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into sustainable and efficient data solutions.
• Supporting the continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and Business Intelligence capabilities.
• Contributing to data quality, governance, and optimization initiatives.
• Participating in ongoing projects related to cloud data platforms and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills and enjoys working in an international environment.We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or a similar domain.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake at an intermediate level.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SQL
• Linux/Bash
• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.
Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

• Customer-oriented, structured, and solution-driven.
• Proactive attitude with the ability to take initiative and think alongside customers and colleagues.
• Comfortable working in an environment where change, innovation, and continuous improvement are key priorities.

Our client is a leading international organisation operating within a fast-paced global environment. The company is recognised for its commitment to operational excellence, continuous improvement, employee development, sustainability, and high standards in workplace experience and facilities management.

• Lead and manage regional facilities operations across multiple sites
• Supervise facilities personnel, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and development

Our client is a well-established international industrial manufacturing company with production facilities in Belgium and abroad. The company is recognised for its strong market position and continuous focus on innovation, customer service and operational excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As Supply Chain Manager you will:

• Lead a Supply Chain organisation of 90 fte (of which 6 direct reports) covering demand planning, customer service and transportation planning.
• Develop and enhance forecasting and demand planning processes to improve service levels, forecast accuracy and business performance.
• Define, implement and monitor relevant Supply Chain KPI's and SLA frameworks to support scalable growth.
• Drive customer segmentation initiatives and align differentiated service levels with planning and supply strategies.
• Support the introduction of new product ranges while contributing to product portfolio rationalisation initiatives.

A successful Supply Chain Manager should have:

• Practical capability in coordinating supply chain activities.
• Experience with planning material and product flows.
• Ability to monitor supply chain information and act on operational priorities.
• Knowledge of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Ability to maintain accurate data for planning and follow-up.
• Confidence working with internal stakeholders on supply chain coordination.
• Collaborate closely with stakeholders including Commercial, Product Marketing, Operations and ICT teams to ensure end-to-end supply chain alignment.
• Lead, coach and develop a team of 6 direct reports and approximately 90 indirect reports.
• A good professional level of Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. With several hundred employees in Belgium and a strong position in its market, the company is currently entering a new phase of growth driven by innovation, strategic partnerships and evolving customer needs.To support this development, our client is looking for a Head of Sales Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the Managing Director and sitting on the local leadership team, you will lead the commercial function, shape the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships and manage a team of experienced sales professionals.Commercial Strategy & Growth

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.
• Identify growth opportunities and drive business development initiatives.
• Monitor commercial performance, sales activity and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the overall business strategy as a member of the management team.
Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 3 sales professionals.
• Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer value and commercial results.
• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.
Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.
Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English

As Receptionist & Facility Officer, you will be the first point of contact for members and visitors and will support the smooth day-to-day operation of the office.
 

You will manage reception and visitor processes, oversee office readiness, coordinate meeting rooms and on-site event logistics, and support essential services such as catering, stationery, mailroom and archives.
 

You will also coordinate preventive and reactive maintenance of key facility systems and assist with practical facility projects, including storage and furniture inventory. Through this varied role, you will help provide a professional, safe and positive working environment for employees, members and visitors. You will work at the  Secretariat in Brussels, reporting directly to the Facility Manager.
 

Your responsibilities 
 

 Your responsibilities will vary based on priorities and projects and may include, but are not limited to: 

 
• bull;    Act as the main point of contact for  members and visitors, ensuring a professional and welcoming reception experience. 
 
• bull;    Carry out daily office checks and take appropriate action to ensure that workspaces are clean, functional and ready for daily operations.
